A LITTLE METHOD TO THE MENU

One good choice beats
a hundred maybes.

Choose a mood, tell us your limits, and we’ll recommend a meal from our curated list.

  1. Your preferences come first. Dietary choices, cooking time, and budget filter the list.
  2. Your cravings narrow it down. Mood, spice, and how adventurous you feel help rank the meals.
  3. You get one clear answer. If it doesn’t hit the spot, try the next best match.

Time and per-serving costs are home-cooking estimates. Dietary labels apply to the listed ingredients; check packaged ingredients for your needs.
